title: Proper finite projection in scalar coordinates
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, Operations o and a RealizationModel model [def-strict-coefficient-system-realization-data] and [def-strict-coefficient-system-operation-data], an arbitrary morphism f:X→Y of schemes, a system M in System(X) and n≥0. Write F_W for scalarReductionDerivedExtension at n, L_W for coefficientSequenceLimit, and P_f for Operations.push(o,f). Define properFiniteReduction(f,n) from scalar reduction of completed-ring direct image to finite constant-ring direct image of scalar reduction by the composite: finiteReductionIso(Y,n) inverse, PurCompactSupport.properComparison for reduction modulo exponent n+1, the separately derived equality finiteDirectImage_eq(f,n), and finite direct image of finiteReductionIso(X,n). These are the coefficient comparisons of [lem-strict-coefficient-finite-geometric-coordinates]. For W=X,Y define μ_W(N) to be reductionEvaluation(n) inverse at L_W N followed by evaluation of the reconstruction counit at N [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Then F_Y(model.push(f)_M) followed by properFiniteReduction(f,n) at L_X M followed by finite direct image of μ_X(M) equals μ_Y(P_f M) followed by the specified proper evaluation of o. No open extension, compactification, constructibility or invertible reconstruction unit is assumed.

proof.text:
use the sectionwise projection equation of model.ordinary as an equality
of ordinary module maps. Apply it to simultaneous K-injective representatives of
M and to their direct images. The universal right-derived comparison carries this
ordinary square to the derived projection square. The comparison on its integral
side is model.push: transpose under the two composite adjunctions, compute on
flat-term K-flat representatives, and use model.model to identify its transpose
with the localization of ordinary.reductionPullComplex. The ordinary conjugacy
and the adjunction triangles recover ordinary.comparison on K-injectives, so
uniqueness of right derivation identifies these whole derived transformations.
The finite proper scalar comparison is the scalar-adjunction mate of the
restriction/direct-image square by its definition. The normalized
finiteReductionIso and finiteDirectImage_eq transport that mate to
properFiniteReduction. Finally counit_projection identifies the scalar adjunct
of each total-limit projection with reductionEvaluation inverse followed by the
evaluated reconstruction counit. Substitution at source and target gives exactly
the displayed equality. Only ordinary section maps and universal derived
comparisons are used, never faithfulness of derived evaluation. Zero systems
satisfy the same equation.

lean.statement:
theorem integralProperFiniteProjection (o : Operations l E)
    (model : RealizationModel l E o) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (M : System l E X) (n : ℕ) :
    (scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E Y n).map ((model.push l E f).hom.app M) ≫
      (properFiniteReduction l E f n).app ((coefficientSequenceLimit l E X).obj M) ≫
      (proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage f
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))).map
          (((calculus l E X).reductionEvaluation n).inv.app
              ((coefficientSequenceLimit l E X).obj M) ≫
            (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E X n).map
              ((calculus l E X).adjunction.counit.app M)) =
    ((calculus l E Y).reductionEvaluation n).inv.app
        ((coefficientSequenceLimit l E Y).obj ((Operations.push l E o f).obj M)) ≫
      (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E Y n).map
        ((calculus l E Y).adjunction.counit.app ((Operations.push l E o f).obj M)) ≫
      ((o.evaluation f).evaluation n).hom.app M
